# A cost stated on a CAD split, which can never hold foreign currency.
#
# `cost_basis_cost:` says what a unit of a split's currency cost in the book's
# currency. On a CAD split in a CAD book there is nothing for it to say, and
# nothing will ever read it: the split establishes no cost basis, so the cost
# is never consulted. Almost always it is on the wrong line of the two.
#
# What this fixture produces: the import is refused, naming the split and the
# reason. Both ways in answer the same — a fresh import and `--strategy
# update` — because a file that means nothing on one path cannot mean
# something on the other.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_update_strategy_respects_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
		cost_basis_cost: "1.4 CAD/USD"
